name: Sweet & Sour Meatballs
description: A hearty meatball dish smothered in a rich sweet and sour pineapple sauce, baked to perfection.
recipeIngredient: For the sauce: ½ cup brown sugar, ½ cup vinegar, 19 oz pineapple tidbits (undrained), ½ tsp salt, 1 Tbsp cornstarch

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together ground beef, onion, cracker crumbs, garlic, pepper, egg, and milk. Chill until firm.
Shape into evenly sized meatballs and place on a greased broiler pan.
Broil to brown on all sides, watching carefully.
Place meatballs in a casserole dish.
To make the sauce, combine brown sugar, salt, and cornstarch. Gradually stir in vinegar and soya sauce. Add pineapple tidbits and bring to a boil until thickened and clear.
Pour the sauce over the meatballs and bake in the oven at 350°F for 1 hour.

keywords: sweet and sour meatballs, baked meatballs, pineapple sauce
